name: Karin Keller-Sutter
bio: Karin Keller-Sutter (born Karin Maria Sutter on 22 December 1963 in Niederuzwil, canton of St. Gallen) is a Swiss politician of FDP.The Liberals and a member of the Swiss Federal Council since 1 January 2019. A trained conference interpreter and translator who also taught at commercial vocational schools, she entered politics in Wil (SG), served in the St. Gallen cantonal parliament and from 2000 to 2012 in the cantonal government, where she headed the Security and Justice Department and earned a reputation as a hardliner on asylum and security matters. She represented St. Gallen in the Council of States from 2011 to 2019 and was its president in 2017-2018. After an unsuccessful Federal Council bid in 2010, she was elected to the Federal Council on 5 December 2018. She led the Federal Department of Justice and Police (2019-2022) and has headed the Federal Department of Finance (FDF/DFF) since 1 January 2023. She was Vice President of Switzerland in 2024 and President of the Confederation in 2025. She is internationally known for her role in the March 2023 emergency takeover of Credit Suisse by UBS.
